Pump pattern findings

Study of 6 coins on 7 Oct (EVERYTHING, SNDWITCH, A1, CATCRAFT, RARINU, MINER): price matched against X mentions per hour and key posts. On all six, X mostly reacted AFTER the price moved instead of leading it.

Came before pumps

  • The coin graduating from pump.fun's launch stage to a real exchange (PumpSwap/Raydium).
  • A paid DexScreener promotion (boost / paid profile).
  • A post from the project's own X account.

Warning signs before dumps

  • X mentions peaking while the price is flat or falling.
  • Waves of "Nx from my call, DM for VIP" posts.
  • Big accounts posting "you missed it at $X".
  • Scam warnings from on-chain analysts (A1 fell 44% shortly after a "this is a scam" post).

Earliest signal: Bots announce graduations and boosts within minutes, so those bot posts are the earliest signal visible on X. A once-a-day list is usually too late; the 13:37 and 21:37 scans look for these.

Based on one day and six coins: a first read, not a rule.
